record.summary: A voluntary, ASEAN-endorsed guide for organisations that design, develop and deploy traditional AI in commercial and non-military or dual-use applications, aimed at alignment and interoperability across ASEAN. It sets seven guiding principles, including transparency and explainability, security and safety, human-centricity and accountability, and a governance framework: internal governance structures, risk impact assessments that set the level of human involvement (human-in-the-loop, over-the-loop or out-of-the-loop), operations management, and disclosure of AI use to stakeholders. It recommends national and regional measures, including an ASEAN Working Group on AI Governance.
record.notes: Endorsed at the 4th ASEAN Digital Ministers' Meeting (ADGMIN) in Singapore on 1-2 February 2024, which also welcomed the recommendation to set up a Working Group on AI Governance under ADGSOM, including initial work on generative AI. Adoption is voluntary; the guide does not replace or supersede existing or upcoming laws and is meant to be a living document reviewed by ASEAN sectoral bodies. Annex A gives an AI risk impact assessment template and Annex B six use cases. Supplemented by the Expanded ASEAN Guide on AI Governance and Ethics – Generative AI (ASEAN-02), a separate publication rather than a new version of this guide.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. Stored: the ASEAN Secretariat's publication page for the guide on asean.org (rendered in a browser on 11 Oct 2026 and printed to PDF on 18 Oct 2026; the plain download fails with HTTP 307), the guide itself (asean.org PDF, 87 pages, 18 Oct 2026), and the Joint Media Statement of the 4th ASEAN Digital Ministers' Meeting, both the asean.org page dated 2 February 2024 (saved with a browser) and its endorsed PDF. The guide confirms the title, the content of the summary and notes, its voluntary nature and 'Copyright 2024'; the publication page gives the ASEAN Secretariat as author and publisher and the year 2024; the Joint Media Statement confirms that the ministers endorsed the guide at the meeting in Singapore on 1-2 February 2024. Neither source gives the day of endorsement, so date_published stays at the month. The endorsed PDF's header reads 'as of 31 January 2023', an evident slip for 2024 in a statement on a February 2024 meeting.

judgment.status_reasoning: A voluntary guide endorsed by the ASEAN Digital Ministers on 1-2 February 2024 and still listed as a current ASEAN publication. The 2025 Expanded Guide supplements it rather than replacing it; nothing stored shows it withdrawn. Published (non-binding, current).
judgment.scope_reasoning: An intergovernmental AI governance and ethics framework with risk-based governance measures and recommendations to governments; in scope with no note.
judgment.date_reasoning: The ministers endorsed the guide at their meeting in Singapore on 1-2 February 2024 (Joint Media Statement, page dated 2 February 2024); the guide's copyright year and the publication page give 2024. No source gives the day of endorsement within the two-day meeting, so the published 2024-02 is kept.
judgment.topics_reasoning: The published topics are now supported by the guide: risk-based classification (risk impact assessments and human involvement set by level of risk), human oversight (human-in-the-loop, over-the-loop, out-of-the-loop), transparency & labelling (transparency and explainability principle; disclosure of AI use), accountability & liability (accountability and integrity principle; internal governance roles), international cooperation (interoperability and the ASEAN working group). Left unchanged.
